cards.ex: En 2010 vi París por primera vez.
cards.exHe: In 2010 I saw Paris for the first time.

cards.ex: Al regresar a casa, me ducho y ceno.
cards.exHe: When I get back home, I shower and have dinner.

cards.ex: Los domingos me relajo en la playa.
cards.exHe: On Sundays I relax on the beach.

cards.ex: Me encontré con una amiga en el metro.
cards.exHe: I ran into a friend on the metro.

cards.ex: Esta noche he quedado con unos amigos para cenar.
cards.exHe: Tonight I've arranged to meet some friends for dinner.

cards.ex: Sonríe, que te hago una foto.
cards.exHe: Smile, I'm taking a photo of you.

cards.ex: El ladrón huyó por la ventana.
cards.exHe: The thief ran away through the window.

cards.ex: Es difícil elegir entre tantas playas.
cards.exHe: It's hard to choose between so many beaches.

cards.ex: ¿Puedes traer pan cuando vuelvas?
cards.exHe: Can you bring bread when you come back?

cards.ex: ¿Cuánto mides? Mido un metro sesenta y cinco.
cards.exHe: How tall are you? I'm one metre sixty-five.

cards.ex: Cierro la ventana porque hace frío.
cards.exHe: I'm closing the window because it's cold.

cards.ex: Anoche me dormí viendo una película.
cards.exHe: Last night I fell asleep watching a film.

cards.ex: Mi jefe se jubila el año que viene.
cards.exHe: My boss is retiring next year.

cards.ex: ¿Te apetece ir al cine esta noche?
cards.exHe: Do you feel like going to the cinema tonight?

cards.ex: Te voy a mostrar las fotos del viaje.
cards.exHe: I'm going to show you the photos from the trip.

cards.ex: Mi amiga lo organizó todo: hoteles, vuelos y excursiones.
cards.exHe: My friend organised everything: hotels, flights and excursions.

cards.ex: Tengo ganas de volver a España.
cards.exHe: I'm looking forward to going back to Spain.
cards.he: to feel like, to look forward to

cards.ex: Nos divertimos mucho en la fiesta.
cards.exHe: We had a lot of fun at the party.
cards.he: to have fun, to enjoy oneself

cards.ex: Apunto todas las palabras nuevas en mi cuaderno.
cards.exHe: I note down all the new words in my notebook.

cards.ex: Se me ha estropeado el móvil.
cards.exHe: My phone has broken.

cards.ex: No lo hice, pero lo intenté.
cards.exHe: I didn't do it, but I tried.

cards.ex: Con tanto ruido no me puedo concentrar.
cards.exHe: With so much noise I can't concentrate.

cards.ex: Tengo que editar el vídeo antes de subirlo.
cards.exHe: I have to edit the video before uploading it.

cards.ex: El sábado vamos de compras al centro.
cards.exHe: On Saturday we're going shopping in the centre.

cards.ex: Voy a tender la ropa antes de que llueva.
cards.exHe: I'm going to hang out the washing before it rains.

cards.ex: No me gusta planchar, prefiero ropa que no se arrugue.
cards.exHe: I don't like ironing, I prefer clothes that don't crease.

cards.ex: El sol seca la ropa en una hora.
cards.exHe: The sun dries the clothes in an hour.

cards.ex: Tengo que ordenar mi habitación.
cards.exHe: I have to tidy my room.

cards.ex: Yo cocino y mi compañero de piso friega los platos.
cards.exHe: I cook and my flatmate washes the dishes.

cards.ex: Me cepillo los dientes después de desayunar.
cards.exHe: I brush my teeth after breakfast.

cards.ex: Por la tarde suelo hacer yoga.
cards.exHe: In the afternoon I usually do yoga.

cards.ex: Fuimos a un restaurante cerca de la playa.
cards.exHe: We went to a restaurant near the beach.

cards.ex: Leo un libro en español antes de dormir.
cards.exHe: I read a book in Spanish before going to sleep.

cards.ex: Me siento mucho mejor después de las vacaciones.
cards.exHe: I feel much better after the holidays.

cards.ex: Siéntate aquí, a mi lado.
cards.exHe: Sit here, next to me.

cards.ex: La clase empieza a las ocho.
cards.exHe: The class starts at eight.

cards.ex: A veces discutimos sobre política durante la cena.
cards.exHe: Sometimes we argue about politics at dinner.

cards.ex: ¿Qué comisteis en Lisboa?
cards.exHe: What did you eat in Lisbon?

cards.ex: Practico español quince minutos al día.
cards.exHe: I practise Spanish for fifteen minutes a day.

cards.ex: No pasa nada si cometes errores, así se aprende.
cards.exHe: It's fine if you make mistakes, that's how you learn.

cards.ex: Mi profesora comentó que mi pronunciación ha mejorado.
cards.exHe: My teacher remarked that my pronunciation has improved.

cards.ex: Me lavo la cara con agua fría por la mañana.
cards.exHe: I wash my face with cold water in the morning.

cards.ex: Hoy me he levantado muy tarde.
cards.exHe: Today I got up very late.

cards.ex: Me peino y salgo de casa.
cards.exHe: I comb my hair and leave the house.

cards.ex: En el autobús aprovecho para repasar el vocabulario.
cards.exHe: On the bus I take the chance to review vocabulary.
cards.he: to make the most of, to take advantage of

cards.ex: Compré fruta en el mercado.
cards.exHe: I bought fruit at the market.

cards.ex: Vivo en un piso pequeño con dos amigas.
cards.exHe: I live in a small flat with two friends.

cards.ex: No encuentro mis gafas de sol.
cards.exHe: I can't find my sunglasses.

cards.ex: Busco un piso que tenga terraza.
cards.exHe: I'm looking for a flat with a terrace.

cards.ex: Antes del análisis de sangre hay que ayunar doce horas.
cards.exHe: Before a blood test you have to fast for twelve hours.

cards.ex: Mi abuela reza todas las mañanas.
cards.exHe: My grandmother prays every morning.

cards.ex: Mi vecino cumple cuarenta años el lunes.
cards.exHe: My neighbour turns forty on Monday.
cards.he: to have a birthday, to turn (an age)

cards.ex: En la película, el protagonista mata a su enemigo.
cards.exHe: In the film, the hero kills his enemy.

cards.ex: Siempre digo la verdad a mis amigos.
cards.exHe: I always tell my friends the truth.
cards.note: digo, dices, dice, decimos, decís, dicen

cards.ex: Mi planta se está muriendo porque no la riego.
cards.exHe: My plant is dying because I don't water it.

cards.ex: Celebramos el cumpleaños de mi madre en un restaurante.
cards.exHe: We celebrated my mother's birthday in a restaurant.

cards.ex: Hoy no nos hemos bañado porque hacía mal tiempo.
cards.exHe: We didn't go swimming today because the weather was bad.
cards.he: to bathe, to swim (in the sea)

cards.ex: Revisa el texto antes de enviarlo.
cards.exHe: Check the text before sending it.

cards.ex: La cafetería está arriba, en el segundo piso.
cards.exHe: The café is upstairs, on the second floor.

cards.ex: No cabe nada más en la maleta.
cards.exHe: Nothing else fits in the suitcase.

cards.ex: Quiero reducir el tiempo que paso con el móvil.
cards.exHe: I want to reduce the time I spend on my phone.

cards.ex: En Mallorca alquilamos una moto y conduje yo.
cards.exHe: In Mallorca we rented a motorbike and I drove.

cards.ex: Quiero que vengas conmigo a la fiesta.
cards.exHe: I want you to come to the party with me.

cards.ex: ¿Vienes a cenar con nosotros esta noche?
cards.exHe: Are you coming to dinner with us tonight?

cards.ex: Esta noche dormimos en un hotel junto a la playa.
cards.exHe: Tonight we're sleeping in a hotel by the beach.

cards.ex: Hoy estoy agotada, me quedo en casa.
cards.exHe: I'm exhausted today, I'm staying at home.

cards.ex: Hierve el agua antes de echar la pasta.
cards.exHe: Boil the water before adding the pasta.

cards.ex: No me atrevo a hablar español con desconocidos.
cards.exHe: I don't dare to speak Spanish with strangers.

cards.ex: Describe tu ciudad en cinco frases.
cards.exHe: Describe your city in five sentences.

cards.ex: Te espero en la puerta del cine.
cards.exHe: I'll wait for you at the cinema entrance.

cards.ex: Mi hermano se afeita todas las mañanas.
cards.exHe: My brother shaves every morning.

cards.ex: Apártate, que viene una moto.
cards.exHe: Move aside, there's a motorbike coming.
cards.he: to move aside, to step back

cards.ex: Se me ha roto la pantalla del móvil.
cards.exHe: My phone screen has broken.

cards.ex: No me gusta acostarme tarde.
cards.exHe: I don't like going to bed late.

cards.ex: Subimos a la cima del volcán en tres horas.
cards.exHe: We climbed to the top of the volcano in three hours.

cards.ex: ¡Lo has clavado! Es exactamente así.
cards.exHe: You've nailed it! That's exactly right.
cards.he: to nail; (slang) to get it spot on

cards.ex: En Tenerife buceamos con tortugas.
cards.exHe: In Tenerife we dived with turtles.

cards.ex: Indonesia alberga miles de especies de animales.
cards.exHe: Indonesia is home to thousands of animal species.
cards.he: to house, to be home to

cards.ex: La cultura se refleja en la arquitectura y la gastronomía.
cards.exHe: Culture is reflected in architecture and food.

cards.ex: Ella lidera un equipo de diez personas.
cards.exHe: She leads a team of ten people.

cards.ex: Ahora mismo te he mandado los deberes.
cards.exHe: I've just sent you the homework.

cards.ex: Antes trabajaba en una tienda, pero ahora estudio.
cards.exHe: I used to work in a shop, but now I'm studying.

cards.ex: Hoy ha llovido mucho.
cards.exHe: It has rained a lot today.

cards.ex: Esta mañana he desayunado muy rápido.
cards.exHe: This morning I had breakfast very quickly.

cards.ex: Esta noche vamos a cenar fuera.
cards.exHe: Tonight we're eating out.

cards.ex: Ayer fui a la playa con unos amigos.
cards.exHe: Yesterday I went to the beach with some friends.

cards.ex: El año pasado viajamos a Barcelona.
cards.exHe: Last year we travelled to Barcelona.
cards.note: El año pasado hicimos el Camino

cards.ex: Esta semana he tenido dos clases de español.
cards.exHe: This week I've had two Spanish classes.

cards.ex: Ahora mismo no puedo hablar, te llamo luego.
cards.exHe: I can't talk right now, I'll call you later.
cards.note: Ahora mismo te he mandado los deberes

cards.ex: Hasta hace una semana no sabíamos que íbamos a venir.
cards.exHe: Until a week ago we didn't know we were coming.
cards.note: no sabíamos que íbamos a venir

cards.ex: Para el próximo día, practica con esta web.
cards.exHe: For next time, practise with this website.

cards.ex: Estaba cansada porque no dormí durante la noche anterior.
cards.exHe: I was tired because I didn't sleep the night before.

cards.ex: Cada mañana tomo un café en la terraza.
cards.exHe: Every morning I have a coffee on the terrace.

cards.ex: En esta isla hace viento solo por la noche.
cards.exHe: On this island it's only windy at night.
cards.note: Hace viento sólo por la noche

cards.ex: A las nueve iremos a un restaurante japonés.
cards.exHe: At nine we'll go to a Japanese restaurant.

cards.ex: En 2010 vi París por primera vez.
cards.exHe: In 2010 I saw Paris for the first time.

cards.ex: A partir de los dieciocho años se puede votar.
cards.exHe: From the age of eighteen you can vote.

cards.ex: Cuando el año empieza, mucha gente hace una lista de propósitos.
cards.exHe: When the year begins, many people write a list of resolutions.

cards.ex: Al regresar del viaje, estaba agotada.
cards.exHe: When I got back from the trip, I was exhausted.

cards.ex: Poco a poco entiendo más cuando habla mi profesora.
cards.exHe: Little by little I understand more when my teacher speaks.

cards.ex: Hay veces que no tengo ganas de estudiar.
cards.exHe: There are times when I don't feel like studying.

cards.ex: Siempre desayuno antes de salir de casa.
cards.exHe: I always have breakfast before leaving the house.

cards.ex: No tenía hambre, entonces no cené.
cards.exHe: I wasn't hungry, so I didn't have dinner.

cards.ex: Hay una cafetería entre el banco y la farmacia.
cards.exHe: There's a café between the bank and the pharmacy.

cards.ex: Encima de la calle hay una pasarela para los peatones.
cards.exHe: Above the street there's a pedestrian bridge.
cards.note: encima de la calle hay una pasarela

cards.ex: La cafetería está arriba, en el segundo piso.
cards.exHe: The café is upstairs, on the second floor.

cards.ex: Fuera hace mucho calor, mejor nos quedamos dentro.
cards.exHe: It's very hot outside, we'd better stay inside.

cards.ex: Según el mapa, el hotel está a diez minutos.
cards.exHe: According to the map, the hotel is ten minutes away.

cards.ex: Llévate un paraguas por si llueve.
cards.exHe: Take an umbrella in case it rains.

cards.ex: Habla como si fuera de Madrid.
cards.exHe: She speaks as if she were from Madrid.

cards.ex: Mi madre tampoco sabe cocinar paella.
cards.exHe: My mother can't cook paella either.

cards.ex: No tomo café ni té por la noche.
cards.exHe: I don't drink coffee or tea at night.

cards.ex: Todo es muy preocupante; por esto casi no veo las noticias.
cards.exHe: Everything is very worrying; that's why I hardly watch the news.
cards.note: Por esto es todo tan frustrante

cards.ex: La mayoría de la gente era turista.
cards.exHe: Most of the people were tourists.

cards.ex: Estudio español para poder hablar con la gente.
cards.exHe: I study Spanish so I can talk to people.

cards.ex: Todavía no he visto una ciudad más grande.
cards.exHe: I still haven't seen a bigger city.
cards.note: Todavía no he visto una ciudad más grande

cards.ex: Al final dormimos alrededor de las once.
cards.exHe: In the end we went to sleep around eleven.

cards.ex: En aquella época vivía con mis padres.
cards.exHe: At that time I lived with my parents.

cards.ex: En aquellos tiempos no había móviles.
cards.exHe: In those days there were no mobile phones.

cards.ex: De niña pasaba los veranos en casa de mis abuelos.
cards.exHe: As a child I spent the summers at my grandparents' house.
cards.note: De niña vivía en el campo

cards.ex: De joven, mi padre tocaba la guitarra.
cards.exHe: When he was young, my father played the guitar.

cards.ex: Antes leía el periódico cada mañana.
cards.exHe: I used to read the newspaper every morning.

cards.ex: Cuando era pequeña, quería ser profesora.
cards.exHe: When I was little, I wanted to be a teacher.

cards.ex: Es un sitio precioso; sin embargo, hay demasiados turistas.
cards.exHe: It's a beautiful place; however, there are too many tourists.

cards.ex: Este animal habita exclusivamente en la isla de Komodo.
cards.exHe: This animal lives only on the island of Komodo.

cards.ex: Me desperté a las siete, como de costumbre.
cards.exHe: I woke up at seven, as usual.
cards.note: Me desperté a las siete, como de costumbre

cards.ex: Últimamente las noticias me agobian.
cards.exHe: Lately the news overwhelms me.

cards.ex: Mañana no puedo quedar, curro todo el día.
cards.exHe: I can't meet tomorrow, I'm working all day.

cards.ex: Fue a la fiesta a regañadientes, pero al final se lo pasó genial.
cards.exHe: He went to the party reluctantly, but in the end he had a great time.
cards.note: Fue a la fiesta a regañadientes

cards.ex: El guía nos guió por el parque de Komodo.
cards.exHe: The guide led us through the Komodo park.
cards.note: el guía nos guió (the guide led us)

cards.ex: El guía nos guió durante todo el recorrido.
cards.exHe: The guide led us through the whole tour.

cards.ex: El recorrido duró tres horas.
cards.exHe: The tour lasted three hours.
cards.note: hacer un recorrido = to do a tour

cards.ex: Dimos una vuelta por el pueblo antes de cenar.
cards.exHe: We took a walk around the village before dinner.
cards.note: dar una vuelta = to take a stroll

cards.ex: Llevo el agua en la bolsa.
cards.exHe: I carry the water in the bag.

cards.ex: Fuimos a otra isla en barco.
cards.exHe: We went to another island by boat.
cards.note: Fuimos A otra isla — with a

cards.ex: Nueve personas trabajaban en el barco.
cards.exHe: Nine people worked on the boat.
cards.note: 9 personas que trabajaban en el barco

cards.ex: La arena de esa playa es rosa.
cards.exHe: The sand on that beach is pink.

cards.ex: Los dragones de Komodo parecen estatuas.
cards.exHe: The Komodo dragons look like statues.

cards.ex: Los dragones parecen estatuas.
cards.exHe: The dragons look like statues.

cards.ex: Sólo puedes verla si la marea está baja.
cards.exHe: You can only see it when the tide is low.

cards.ex: Comimos pescado fresco en el pueblo.
cards.exHe: We ate fresh fish in the village.

cards.ex: Mucho pescado y mucho coral.
cards.exHe: Lots of fish and lots of coral.

cards.ex: Hay medusas en el agua, ten cuidado.
cards.exHe: There are jellyfish in the water, be careful.

cards.ex: Habíamos olvidado la cantimplora.
cards.exHe: We had forgotten the water bottle.

cards.ex: Teníamos mucha sed.
cards.exHe: We were very thirsty.

cards.ex: Empezamos a andar y teníamos mucha sed.
cards.exHe: We started walking and we were very thirsty.

cards.ex: El bebé necesita pañales.
cards.exHe: The baby needs diapers.

cards.ex: Tomamos la merienda a las cinco.
cards.exHe: We have our snack at five.
cards.note: merendar = to have an afternoon snack

cards.ex: Mi amiga vive en Inglaterra.
cards.exHe: My friend lives in England.

cards.ex: Hay que tener paciencia con los verbos.
cards.exHe: You need patience with the verbs.

cards.ex: Esta frase ya está traducida.
cards.exHe: This sentence is already translated.

cards.ex: ¡Es una buena prueba!
cards.exHe: It's a good test!

cards.ex: Habíamos olvidado el agua.
cards.exHe: We had forgotten the water.

cards.ex: Me regalaba un ramo de flores cada día.
cards.exHe: He used to give me a bouquet of flowers every day.
cards.note: ahora ya no me lo regala

cards.ex: Me regaló un ramo de flores.
cards.exHe: He gave me a bouquet of flowers.

cards.ex: Anoche me acosté a la una.
cards.exHe: Last night I went to bed at one.

cards.ex: Incluso vimos tiburones.
cards.exHe: We even saw sharks.

cards.ex: Mi hermana está embarazada.
cards.exHe: My sister is pregnant.

cards.ex: Me alegro mucho por ti.
cards.exHe: I'm very happy for you.

cards.ex: Enfermó durante el viaje.
cards.exHe: He got sick during the trip.

cards.ex: Me puse enferma en el barco.
cards.exHe: I fell ill on the boat.
cards.note: ponerse + adjective = a change of state

cards.ex: Se puso a llorar en la playa.
cards.exHe: She burst into tears on the beach.
cards.note: ponerse a + infinitive = to suddenly start

cards.ex: Una desgracia es algo muy horrible.
cards.exHe: A desgracia is something truly horrible.

cards.ex: Es un sentimiento muy fuerte.
cards.exHe: It's a very strong feeling.

cards.ex: Me siento culpable.
cards.exHe: I feel guilty.

cards.ex: Ya hacía muchos años que iba a terapia.
cards.exHe: She had been going to therapy for many years.

cards.ex: La aplicación es muy cómoda.
cards.exHe: The app is very convenient.

cards.ex: Es una idea muy práctica.
cards.exHe: It's a very practical idea.

cards.ex: Si quieres estar más organizada con tus gastos.
cards.exHe: If you want to be more organized with your spending.

cards.ex: Estuvimos separados hasta las cuatro.
cards.exHe: We were apart until four.

cards.ex: Para controlar los gastos del día a día.
cards.exHe: To keep track of day-to-day expenses.

cards.ex: Cada gasto tiene su categoría.
cards.exHe: Every expense has its category.

cards.ex: Esta aplicación puede servir para viajar.
cards.exHe: This app can be useful for travelling.
cards.note: servir para = to be useful for

cards.ex: Vas actualizando la aplicación.
cards.exHe: You keep updating the app as you go.

cards.ex: Escribí una recomendación para mi profesora.
cards.exHe: I wrote a review for my teacher.

cards.ex: También para el día a día.
cards.exHe: Also for everyday life.
cards.note: los gastos del día a día

cards.ex: El primer día fuimos a bucear.
cards.exHe: On the first day we went diving.
cards.note: EL primer día (not EN el primer día)

cards.ex: ¡Hola! ¿Qué te cuentas?
cards.exHe: Hi! What's new?
cards.note: Literally 'what do you tell me'. Friendlier than ¿Cómo estás?

cards.ex: Puedes coger un barco a otra isla.
cards.exHe: You can take a boat to another island.
cards.note: In Spain: coger el autobús. In Latin America it is vulgar — use tomar there.

cards.ex: En Indonesia hay muchas islas habitadas.
cards.exHe: In Indonesia there are many inhabited islands.

cards.ex: Indonesia es el cuarto país con más población.
cards.exHe: Indonesia is the fourth most populated country.

cards.ex: Es el país con más población del mundo.
cards.exHe: It is the most populated country in the world.
cards.note: con más población = with the largest population.

cards.ex: Este es mi propio hotel.
cards.exHe: This is my own hotel.
cards.note: Goes before the noun: mi propio coche, su propia casa.

cards.ex: Los dueños de la mayoría de hoteles son extranjeros.
cards.exHe: The owners of most hotels are foreigners.
cards.note: ser dueño DE algo = to be the owner of something.

cards.ex: Los dueños son extranjeros y los trabajadores son locales.
cards.exHe: The owners are foreigners and the workers are local.

cards.ex: Tienen muchos trabajadores locales.
cards.exHe: They have many local workers.
cards.note: From the verb trabajar — to work.

cards.ex: Los trabajadores de los hoteles son locales.
cards.exHe: The hotel workers are local.
cards.note: Same form for both genders. Also a noun: un local = a shop or business premises.

cards.ex: El sueldo de los trabajadores locales es bajo.
cards.exHe: The local workers' salary is low.
cards.note: Also: el salario. cobrar el sueldo = to get paid.

cards.ex: Se despertó con un dolor muy fuerte entre las cejas.
cards.exHe: He woke up with a very strong pain between his eyebrows.
cards.note: tener dolor de cabeza = to have a headache.

cards.ex: Le dolía entre las cejas.
cards.exHe: It hurt between his eyebrows.
cards.note: Don't confuse with la oreja — ear.

cards.ex: El dolor era de la presión.
cards.exHe: The pain was from the pressure.
cards.note: Also: la presión arterial = blood pressure.

cards.ex: El dolor era de la sinusitis.
cards.exHe: The pain was from the sinusitis.
cards.note: Words ending in -itis are always feminine: la bronquitis, la gastritis.

cards.ex: Fue al doctor y le dijo que podía continuar con el buceo.
cards.exHe: He went to the doctor and was told he could keep diving.
cards.note: ir al médico = to go to the doctor. Both doctor and médico work.

cards.ex: Le dijo que podía continuar con el buceo.
cards.exHe: He told him he could continue with the diving.

cards.ex: Pon la leche en la nevera.
cards.exHe: Put the milk in the fridge.
cards.note: nevera (not nevra). In Latin America: el refrigerador, la heladera.

cards.ex: Odio levantarme temprano.
cards.exHe: I hate getting up early.
cards.note: Opposite: amar, encantar. odiar a alguien — with a before a person.

cards.ex: Me gustan las zanahorias crudas.
cards.exHe: I like raw carrots.

cards.ex: A mi hija no le gusta la oscuridad.
cards.exHe: My daughter doesn't like the dark.

cards.ex: Perdí el autobús esta mañana.
cards.exHe: I missed the bus this morning.
cards.note: Stem change e→ie: pierdo, pierdes, pierde. perderse = to get lost.

cards.ex: En la isla hay muchos loros de colores.
cards.exHe: On the island there are many colourful parrots.
cards.note: hablar como un loro = to talk nonstop.

cards.ex: Metí el pasaporte en la mochila.
cards.exHe: I put the passport in the backpack.
cards.note: meter EN — to put inside. poner = to put on something.

cards.ex: La llave no entra en la cerradura.
cards.exHe: The key doesn't go into the lock.
cards.note: From the verb cerrar — to close. la llave = key.

cards.ex: El restaurante está en la esquina.
cards.exHe: The restaurant is on the corner.
cards.note: esquina = an outside corner, in the street. el rincón = a corner inside a room.

cards.ex: Me robaron la cartera en el autobús.
cards.exHe: They stole my wallet on the bus.
cards.note: robar ALGO A ALGUIEN — to steal something from someone.

cards.ex: Esto es mío y eso es tuyo.
cards.exHe: This is mine and that is yours.
cards.note: esto = near me, eso = near you, aquello = far from both. Neuter forms — no noun follows.

cards.ex: Me he comido un bocadillo de queso.
cards.exHe: I had a cheese sandwich.
cards.note: Shortened to un bocata in speech. el sándwich is made with sliced bread.

cards.ex: No me di cuenta de que era tan tarde.
cards.exHe: I didn't realise it was so late.
cards.note: Always darse cuenta DE algo: me doy cuenta, me di cuenta.

cards.ex: Es el único sitio donde puedes ver dragones.
cards.exHe: It's the only place where you can see dragons.
cards.note: sitio = lugar. Also a website: un sitio web.

cards.ex: Es el único sitio donde hay dragones.
cards.exHe: It's the only place where there are dragons.
cards.note: Before the noun = the only one. After it = unique: un lugar único.

cards.ex: Indonesia es el cuarto país con más población.
cards.exHe: Indonesia is the fourth most populated country.
cards.note: primero, segundo, tercero, cuarto, quinto. Also written 4º.
